title: The Fairphone 6 Plus is the midrange phone we desperately needed
summary: The Fairphone 6 Plus feels like an extremely average midrange Android phone and I couldn’t be more thrilled. Meeting that bar for a “decent midrange Android phone” means the Fairphone 6 Plus needs to offer a good, basic camera system.
